statement: The explicit reciprocal, contour, disk-growth and fixed-window multiplicity budgets in §1 suffice for the RST048 retained-edge upper construction over ordinary integer coefficients. Fixed Selberg-class GRH in the zero-free-half-plane sense provides these inputs with the mesh decreased by 1/(1+d).

At every fixed Selberg degree under GRH, a tested Mellin shift identifies the pole-subtracted complementary function with the critical-line inverse transform of -F(s)/s in L². De Roton Theorem 2 yields the matching liminf by continuous-to-integer scale inclusion.

For each fixed Selberg-class F under its GRH, the unanchored Cauchy-boundary distance has limit (log N) Delta_N,F² equal to the sum of m_rho²/|rho|² over distinct nontrivial zeros, allowing any fixed pole order at 1.
